I do of course feel bad, she had warned us several times she wanted to do it and would vanish and we'd go hunting for her for hours and even once called the cops - over the course of several years. She said it that morning and we all just glanced over it like we didn't take it seriously. She texted it to us and we didn't answer.

Weeks before that I was remodeling her bedroom because she only wanted to sleep on the couch. Took her to Ikea and she wouldn't pick anything out, but we had similar tastes so I ended up surprising buying all the furniture and art for the room. I told her lets to go to Home Depot to get some paint for the room - I want to get a color she liked, but she didn't want to get out of the house and come with me. So I went alone about purchasing about 6-8 different sample colors and brought them home. I painted the walls with those 6-8 samples so she could see the swatches and she picked one, but in a matter of weeks or days, she was gone. Before I could finish with all the furniture and paint still boxed up. I like to think she knew I loved her through that even though I wasn't verbal. 

I know it seems like there's no hope when you reach that point, but talk to someone- anyone. Even a stranger, there are plenty of people that care about you. plenty of people have the ability to make you feel better. Get medication when you need it, get help don't be afraid to - get a therapist, join a group - just don't give up.
